name: 2020-2c-recuperatorio-parcial1
title: Adventure Games III: Hole prototype refactoring
description: A graphic adventure engine with rooms, a PlayableCharacter that moves and jumps, portable and non-portable objects, and a prototype Hole StageObject that the character jumps over. The student must remove the duplicated code in HoleTest and in Hole's instance creation, and replace the isKindOf: ifs in Room>>moveFrom:to:, PlayableCharacter>>jump and NonPortableObject class>>assertCanContain: with polymorphism.

design.notes: The isKindOf: Hole checks are spread over three classes (Room, PlayableCharacter, NonPortableObject class) and must be turned into messages the whole StageObject hierarchy understands, including the absent-object case in Room and the jump distance computed from the hole's size, while a 62-test suite must keep passing.
